summary: Iteration 45 Compare Timeline — verified backend snapshot dedupe + timeline endpoint across all 3 deep-dive pathways (edu/psych/med), and confirmed the DeepDiveCompareView UI correctly renders the timeline section (headline, bars, list) when count > 1. All new + regression suites pass (52/52 excluding 1 pre-existing skip).

issues: Sparkline bars are visually small when both snapshots share the same aligned_pct (e.g. 40%); the bars sit at the bottom of the 96px container and the shared '40%' label is duplicated left/right with no x-axis date labels. Consider adding tick labels under each bar or a min-height floor for very short series so parents can distinguish snapshots at a glance.

action_items: Optional UX polish: add date/tick labels under each sparkline bar in the timeline section and consider a floor height so tiny percentages remain visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Snapshot dedupe key = f"{creator_ts}|{partner_ts}" is correct but relies on `updated_at` always being present; the fallback to `created_at` handles legacy docs. If a client ever POSTs `answers/bulk` twice without a value change, `_upsert` still bumps updated_at, so a duplicate 'view' triggered right after a re-run will still create a new snapshot even when responses didn't actually change. This matches the spec (`re-runs assessment`) but callers should note it.

`_load_comparison` writes the snapshot inside the same request that serves the comparison — if the Mongo insert transiently fails the view still succeeds silently (no try/except around insert). Consider wrapping in try/except + logger.exception so a snapshot write failure doesn't propagate to the user but is at least observable.

GET /{share_id}/timeline currently returns the full snapshot documents (including `top_highlights`) — fine for now, but if snapshots accumulate over months this response can grow unbounded. A `?limit=N` query param and a Mongo index on (share_id, created_at) would help.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (timeline section, bars, list all render as spec'd)

seed_data_creation: During test runs: edu/psych/med_deep_assessments primed via POST /answers/bulk + /complete for parent1 and parent2. Test-created shares are revoked in autouse teardown; deep_dive_compare_snapshots rows for those shares are deleted in teardown. UI-verification seed data was also cleaned up (share revoked + 4 snapshots deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter45 verified end-to-end. Snapshot rows are created on first GET /compare/{share_id} (or /pdf) and deduped by (creator_updated_at, partner_updated_at). To force a new snapshot in future tests, mutate the assessment's updated_at directly via Mongo (the public API bumps it on every write). Timeline UI hides itself when count <= 1 (single-point 'chart' would be meaningless) — this is intentional per spec.
